tactics: intro α R S h l
intro α R S h l <;> induction l <;> simp_all
intro α R S h l <;> simp [h]
intro α R S h l <;> have : R = S := funext fun a => funext fun b => propext (h a b) <;> subst this <;> rfl
intro α R S h l <;> exact ⟨fun p => p.imp (fun hr => (h _ _).1 hr), fun p => p.imp (fun hs => (h _ _).2 hs)⟩
